# Key insights (auto-generated from reported figures)

- **Reported sales fell in CHF while organic growth was positive.** Sales: CHF 93.0B (2023) → CHF 91.4B (-1.8%) → CHF 89.5B (-2.0%), yet organic growth was +2.2% and +3.5%. The gap (-4.0 pp, -5.5 pp) is currency translation and portfolio changes, which these sources do not split.
- **Growth is price-led.** Pricing contributed 2.8 of the 3.5 pp organic growth in 2025 (1.5 of 2.2 pp in 2024); real internal growth (volume/mix) was only 0.8% in both years.
- **Profitability weakened.** Underlying trading operating margin: 17.3% → 17.2% → 16.1%. Net profit CHF 11.2B → CHF 9.0B (-19% vs 2023); basic EPS CHF 4.24 → 3.51.
- **Largest product category:** Powdered and Liquid Beverages (CHF 25.1B, 28.1% of 2025 sales); next: PetCare (20.6%) and Nutrition and Health Science (16.0%).
- **Fastest organic growth in 2025:** Confectionery (+8.2%) and Powdered and Liquid Beverages (+7.3%).
- **Biggest CHF declines 2023→2025:** Prepared dishes and cooking aids (-13.3%), Milk products and Ice cream (-11.7%). That is far more than their organic growth (-1.7% / -0.4% and -0.6% / +1.3% in 2024 / 2025) implies, so currency translation and portfolio changes explain much of it.
- **PetCare is the volume-driven category:** 2025 RIG +2.6% against organic growth of +2.2%, i.e. price/mix was negative.
- **Largest segment:** Zone AMS (CHF 34.5B, 38.5% of 2025 sales). **Fastest organic growth in 2025:** Nespresso (+6.0%).
- **Europe vs Americas:** Zone EUR organic growth +4.3% (pricing +3.9%) vs Zone AMS +2.8%, but Zone AMS is 39% of sales.
- **Seasonality (2025):** quarterly shares of annual sales are Q1 25.3%, Q2 24.2%, Q3 24.2%, Q4 26.4%. Group sales are evenly spread (Q4 highest, Q2 lowest), but categories differ: Confectionery is 30% in Q4, Water 29% in Q2.
